scope: Client-only: warm Home/Burrow return splash and Burrow map icons/labels
diagnosis: BurrowEnvironmentGate rearmed its launch handoff whenever a detail/other tab returned to Home or Burrow, even with fully decoded retained views
Every background event also rearmed that handoff, without distinguishing a brief interruption from a long background
The two-frame environment paint handoff previously could not finish while a child page was still open

changes.warmNavigation: Keep existing views mounted and interactive; returning focus does not rearm the launch cover
changes.background: Only a real background of at least 30 minutes may rearm the environment handoff; inactive system dialogs and short resumes do not
changes.preparation: Decode and finish the shared Home/Burrow environment handoff while a child page remains open; the store still commits complete scenes atomically
changes.failure: Warm decode failures retain the complete outgoing scene; initial entry/account replacement keeps its retryable readiness protection
changes.icons: Seven room icons use 80% of their prior width and height, centered in unchanged containers. My Room remains 100%; asset aspect ratios and hit targets are unchanged

targetedCoverage: Repeated detail/interaction/tab returns never cover or block the retained destination
A prepared destination behind a child page needs no additional covered frames on return
Short resumes across day/night and month boundaries remain uncovered
Evicted image-cache entries and transient warm decode failures do not become launch splash
Long resumes and account changes retain preparation and stale-frame protection
All eight entries remain tappable; seven shrink proportionally and My Room is unchanged

nativeQA.scope: Real environment gate/shared native image preparation/BurrowMap in an isolated local QA shell; no production account or full-app end-to-end claim
nativeQA.shortBackgroundResume: passed; retained the existing view state without splash
nativeQA.iconsAndLabels: visually checked; all eight room destinations exposed in native accessibility
nativeQA.note: An older test shell initially lacked ExpoSecureStore and an interrupted run was discarded. The completed run used the newer isolated shell with business/network boundaries disabled.

fullRegression.note: The later-added month/cache-eviction boundary test is also covered by the final 51-test targeted rerun

deployment: No API, database, Admin or client-store deployment performed for this client-only change
